name: Sheraton Grand Danang Beach Resort & Spa
short_description: Sheraton beachfront resort on Da Nang's tranquil Non Nuoc coast near the Marble Mountains, home to the city's longest infinity pool at 250 metres.
ai_summary: The Sheraton Grand Danang is a large five-star beachfront resort set on the quieter Non Nuoc / Bac My An coast in the Ngu Hanh Son district, roughly midway between Da Nang and Hoi An and a short drive from the airport. Its signature feature, praised in nearly every independent review, is a 250-metre infinity pool billed as the longest in Da Nang, running parallel to a private stretch of soft-sand beach. Reviewers from Business Traveller, The Brag and other blogs consistently highlight spacious, contemporary sea- and pool-view rooms, Sheraton Signature Sleep beds, and genuinely warm, attentive service, with staff repeatedly singled out for going out of their way for families. The property is strongly family-oriented, with a kids' club, mini water park and children's beach zone, alongside a Shine Spa and multiple restaurants including the signature steak-and-seafood venue The Grill and beachfront La Plage. Breakfast buffets earn wide praise for variety and quality. Watch-outs are consistent too: the resort's location feels somewhat isolated, so guests can feel dependent on the property for meals, and on-site dining is considered expensive, leaving value opinions mixed. A handful of reviewers also flag inconsistency in maintenance or specific service touchpoints. Overall it reads as a reliably comfortable, well-run beach resort that excels for families and pool lovers.

faqs.question: How far is the resort from Da Nang International Airport?
faqs.answer: The Sheraton Grand Danang sits on Non Nuoc Beach in the Ngu Hanh Son district, roughly 11 kilometres south of Da Nang International Airport, a drive of about 15 to 20 minutes depending on traffic. The resort can arrange airport transfers on request.

faqs.question: What is the resort best known for?
faqs.answer: It is best known for its 250-metre infinity pool, billed as the longest in Da Nang, which runs parallel to a private beach. Reviewers also single out the spacious sea-view rooms, warm service, and extensive family facilities including a kids' club and mini water park.

faqs.question: Is the Sheraton Grand Danang good for families?
faqs.answer: Yes. Independent reviews consistently rate it among the best family resorts in the area, citing the kids' club, children's water park and beach zone, spacious family suites, and staff who go out of their way for children. The huge pool and calm private beach add to its family appeal.
